brand:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: a high-end mobile app naming and logo exploration board, 2400x1600 landscape, for a Chinese dashcam companion application.
Primary request: show THREE compelling, clearly differentiated brand-name and app-icon concepts on one exceptionally polished design presentation. Three generous equal columns. Keep an elegant glacier-silver, very pale icy-blue background and editorial Swiss-style spacing, crisp Chinese typography, no phone frames and no photography. This is an identity concept, not an update of the current app icon. The app connects to a vehicle recorder and saves journeys.
Top-left heading exact text: "每一程，都值得留下".
Three concepts left to right:
A (recommended), exact name "途映", descriptor "旅途 · 影像". The strongest distinctive mark. A softly rounded cobalt-blue app tile; within it, a single refined white ribbon bends into a road leading toward the horizon, its central negative space forms a subtle right-facing play triangle. TWO or THREE bold geometric elements maximum, generous clear space, recognizable at 32px. No literal camera body, no complex aperture. Restrained icy-cyan highlight along one edge, largely flat vector-like forms. Under the large icon put a horizontal mark-and-name lockup "途映" in refined dark-navy Chinese sans-serif and small text "推荐方案". Show a small 48px-style app icon size preview below.
B exact name "行迹", descriptor "行程 · 留痕". An original navy rounded tile with a minimal continuous white route line forming a memorable location/recording glyph; a small clean ice-blue dot, no literal camera, visually different from A. Same large icon, horizontal wordmark and small icon preview layout.
C exact name "驭光", descriptor "驾驶 · 光影". An original ice-silver rounded tile with a bold cobalt abstract forward light-beam / wing form, one elegant geometric stroke creating motion, no gradients full of noise, no car badge. Same large icon, horizontal wordmark and small icon preview layout.
The recommended A icon should be bold and sophisticated, not a generic blue play button. Text must be exact, clearly legible and well-spaced. Each option has lots of breathing room. Add small discreet column labels "A", "B", "C". A thin vertical divider between columns. All icon shapes optically centered, consistent corner radii, clear small-size legibility.
Avoid: camera/lens illustrations, cartoon mascots, shields, 3D chrome, metallic bevels, mock Apple/Geely logos, checkered backgrounds, ornamental stars, meaningless extra text, watermark. No claims about trademark availability.
interface:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile-app design board for the Chinese dashcam app concept "途映", 3072x2048 landscape. Three tall, complete app screen canvases side by side on an airy light icy-blue presentation background, equal height. Readable crisp Chinese typography. Small labels above screens only: "设备", "连接方案", "播放器". No perspective, no hardware phone frames, no cut-off screens.
Common visual language: premium glacier-silver mobile app, very pale blue/white, dark navy text, clear cobalt-blue primary actions, thin consistent rounded line icons, subtle white cards and soft shadows, 44px-style touch targets, restrained luminous cyan accents. Refined and practical, not cluttered. App brand is exact text "途映"; app tile mark is a cobalt rounded square containing a simple white ribbon-road with a subtle right-facing play triangle in negative space, only 2-3 geometric pieces. No camera-shaped brand icon.
SCREEN 1 DEVICE:
Android status bar, small brand icon and "途映" top-left, scanner button top-right. Main title exact "我的记录仪" with small pencil button immediately after title, subtitle "留住每一程". Central elegant floating realistic silver-graphite dashcam with blue optical lens and delicate orbital ring. A tiny photo-edit glyph at the bottom-right of the device picture, small helper "轻触更换设备图片". Under it exact vehicle label "星越L2026款" with a pencil icon, discreet text "车型与图片已保存在本机". Connected green-dot pill "已连接". Broad cobalt button "查看行车录像". Four shortcuts in a clean 2x2 grid: "实时画面", "行车录像", "传输任务", "设备设置". Quiet text button "管理连接". Bottom navigation "设备", "录像", "传输", "设置", device active. No demo mode anywhere. Place a small off-screen design annotation near this first canvas (not within product UI) "标题、车型可改名 / 设备图可更换、恢复默认".
SCREEN 2 CONNECTION SCHEMES:
A well-designed near-full-height rounded bottom sheet titled "连接方案", close X, helper "不知道选哪个？选择自动连接". First compact radio card "自动连接" with "推荐" pill and smaller "自动尝试可用方案".
Then three single-select cards, NEVER abbreviate supported cars with "等". Cards have a heading and full car names rendered as well-spaced wrapping chips, with enough vertical space. The A7 card is selected using pale-blue fill, thin cobalt outline and a filled radio circle at top right.
Card 1 heading "A7 方案". Chips exact: "银河A7", "星耀7", "M7", "TT", "2026款星舰7", "2026款星瑞", "2026款博越", "2026款星越L", "星愿".
Card 2 heading "E5 方案". Chips exact: "银河E5", "星耀8", "2025款星舰7", "2025款星瑞".
Card 3 heading "L6 / L7 方案". Chips exact: "银河L6", "银河L7", "2023/2024款领克07", "2023/2024款领克08". Smaller helper exact "可使用吉行小助手的车型".
Below these cards a quiet section label "未列出的车型可尝试" and three compact outlined radio pills in a row "通用一", "通用二", "通用三". Fixed footer shows "下次自动使用已选方案" above a wide primary button "使用此方案". All text clear, no ellipsis, no “等”. No giant text-only buttons; use consistent spacing and visual hierarchy. Show all three car groups legibly.
SCREEN 3 PLAYER:
A normal portrait custom player page, exact title "行车录像", back arrow and top-right three-dot file drawer menu. Small date/time "2026-10-28 08:26". A 16:9 video preview of a beautiful clear daylight road through mountains, occupying only the upper part of the screen. Below it current time "00:36", progress slider and total time "03:00", small size "186 MB". Control layout: volume icon and speed pill "1.0×" on the LEFT; large cobalt circular PAUSE button precisely centered with smaller 5-second back/forward controls around it; fullscreen icon on RIGHT. NO stop/square button anywhere. A tidy horizontal speed-options tray below with "0.5×", "1×", "1.5×", "2×", "3×", "4×", selected 1× blue, visibly max 4×. A single wide lower action "保存到相册". Small file-menu preview card lower down titled "录像操作", two or three neat rows "分享视频", "截取与打码", "文件信息" with matching line icons, showing these actions belong in the drawer. Keep generous white space, no native browser controls. Bottom navigation may be omitted on the dedicated player page.
No demo mode, no stop button, no IP address scan status, no unsupported invented features or storage statistics. This board is a design concept, not a screenshot of running software. Do not add implementation details, code, heavy gradients, glowing circuit boards, watermarks, or unrelated decorations.
